306
# The sim model decides whether an entry under a folder taken along on a first-link Discard arrived from another device: the latest record that brought the entry, or an ancestor on its agreed path, into the folder from outside decides. Each clause of that rule has its own test that fails when the clause is mutated away: whose record it was, the latest of them, the ancestors on the agreed path, the origin outside the folder, an agreed place outside the folder, a user's move that another device matched first, and entries another device adds between the answer and the build.
# The other tests pin moves within the folder, moves outside it, departures through an ancestor, batches, nested arrivals, re-entry and this device's moves confirmed after the answer, which earlier versions of the model got wrong.
